釈迦如来: Passage and tip falsely say shaved heads distinguish Buddhas; Buddha images commonly have curls/usnisha. Replace with verified Seiryoji transmission and explicit distinction of devotional likeness from portrait evidence.
無常: Original denies any permanence outside the flow of arising and ceasing, overextending conditioned impermanence and erasing the unconditioned distinction. Restrict explanation to conditioned phenomena.
法話: Original creates an unsupported categorical contrast in which 説教 only teaches precepts and 法話 only relates doctrine to daily scenes. Explain actual overlapping usage without invented event or definition.
曼荼羅: Original reduces mandalas to physically entered ritual spaces and denies their pictorial role. Describe diverse diagrammatic, spatial and ritual forms without universal physical-entry claims.
不二一元: Original claims renunciants as a class choose one daily practice and presents an unsupported uniform curriculum. Replace with clearly attributed Advaita doctrine and no invented practitioner behavior.
無明: Original says experiments can measure only selective-attention limits, falsely restricting cognitive research. Explain doctrinal ignorance without unsupported scientific comparison.
真言: Original restricts mantra to Chinese phonetic writing and asserts meaning is irrelevant. Explain sacred utterance, inherited sound and practice without universal orthography or prohibition on studying meaning.
ノンデュアリティ: Original defJa equates all nonduality with a monistic state while traditions differ; replace with non-separation definition and attributed distinct philosophical contexts.
